rev.t: Isobel Coffee House on Lavelle Road is one of those cafés you'll may wanna  keep coming back to. The space is warm, cozy, and beautifully designed, making it perfect for a leisurely coffee date or a relaxed catch-up with friends or if you …
Food is very good.  Their Zucchini fries with dip is very unique and yummmmmy.  Service is done with a smile, Rayees attend to us very well.  Staff is very friendly and cooperative. …

Limited food options and quality is not up to the standards, zucchini fries had almost no zucchini at all and all batter coating. Apricot croissant was 100% not fresh. Hot chocolate and coffee were fine.
